answer: A workable check is biometric deduplication. Each applicant records a live video, and the system stores only a salted template hash, never raw video. One template maps to one identity, so a farm cannot reuse one face across accounts: every fake needs a live person, and a duplicate burns the bond and flags its vertex neighbours. Re-verification returns each epoch like a tide, catching rented faces that lapse. Limits: collisions, privacy risk, and twins or poor cameras can fail, so appeals with a live check are essential; like karst terrain, no two faces match, yet small abuse stays possible.
